reviews.text: I deleted and redownloaded the app after a few months. I cannot login despite resetting my password through my email. There’s no app support available to fix this issue.

reviews.title: Please bring back 30 min workouts!
reviews.text: I love this app! It is a great deal and Cassey is fantastic. The only thing I’m disappointed in, is how long the workouts suddenly are! I loved the 25/30/40 minute workouts, and all of a sudden all of the workouts are now almost an hour long! It’s harder to fit into a busy schedule. Cassey please bring back the shorter workouts!! 🙏🙏

reviews.title: Super Helpful for Busy Schedules
reviews.text:
I have been using the app since its release, and I appreciate the evolution. The workouts fit into my crazy busy day, and the programs really help! 

My only recommendation—having been on the app for so long—I would love to see new material, videos, and more variety. With that said, I’ve thoroughly enjoyed this app and recommend it to people often.

reviews.title: Amazing workouts! Annoying app issue
reviews.text: I love the workouts and the tracking. However, sometimes you want to have it on a larger screen. With the previous version, I could usually use air play or mirror it, but now I usually can’t. I have the settings as required, I can cast everything else, but when it comes to the actual workouts, the app stays frozen. Casting isn’t an option, despite what the app says. So I mirror. I can see the app itself when mirroring, but the play button becomes a pause button and stays on whatever screen it was on when I mirrored it. As soon as I take it off mirror, it allows it to play. I don’t know what needs to be done, but if I can’t stream it at home, I’m not bothering with the subscription anymore.

reviews.title: Best ad-free exercise videos
reviews.text: I already love Casey’s clothes and I saw some of her YouTube videos, but having her workouts all on one app with NO ADS and no subscription needed to watch them is just amazing. For somebody who has a hard time remembering to exercise regularly, this app makes it easier to check that off the list. Even the 5 minute workouts make an impact. I can’t recommend this app enough, especially since there’s no payment required to watch videos. You can pay for the other features if you want, but in this day and age of subscriptions it’s so refreshing that the core purpose of the app is completely free. Also, Casey is just a joy to exercise with. Her commentary makes it fun and passes the time.

reviews.title: Needs Improvement

It comes with perks such as journeys and a community. However, much of the text and buttons weren’t visible suggesting some testing and restructuring is needed. Overall, it’s free to print the calendar and pull up videos on YouTube. While the subscription is inexpensive, it doesn’t seem to be funding improvements or testing of the app. I didn’t find the app worth the subscription.

reviews.title: Love the calendar! Dangerous Social Media aspect - parents beware!!!
reviews.text:
Overall, I love the app! I’ve been using it for about 1.5 years now and it’s been a great tool! I’m happy to pay the subscription because it’s cheaper than a gym membership and I’ll actually use it. I love that the calendar is provided for me and I don’t have to think too about coming up with a workout plan. 

I only give it two stars due to a serious safety concern I have about the social media aspect of the app. There are absolutely zero security features or privacy settings for users. Absolutely everything is public. Additionally, minors and adults interact freely and can post pictures, comment on one another’s posts, and private message one another. This is a breeding ground for manipulation and abuse!!! I do not believe there are many moderators for it either. Recently a predator posted photographic content, disturbing and frightening many of the young women. It took much too long for the account and the post to be taken down. So parents, unless they do a radical rebuild of the social media aspect or get rid of it all together, if your child or teen is asking to download this app, I would say no. Find a different fitness app for them that has similar features without the social media aspect.

reviews.title: Great concept needs some improvements!
reviews.text:
Love the set up of this app, especially the journaling function on the journey. I am doing a free one week premium trial but not sure if I'll continue once the trial is over bc the app needs some improvements. 

I don't have a tv that I can airplay too and the videos are so small on my phone. I tried using the app on my iPad for a larger screen but it's not set up for iPad use so it was still a mobile sized screen :( 

I would love to be able to customize my journey by replacing the redundant workouts assigned with something of my choice.

When I watch the workout videos from the journey calendar, anytime I have to minimize the video for a second it just closes it all the way and restarts from the beginning. Would love if it either kept my place or minimized into the corner of my screen. I find the videos shutting out a lot and restarting while I'm getting prepared. 

Also when I set up my journey, it made me take before pics and I was not able to do it at that time but I couldn't get past the screen until I took pictures. There should be an option to add these later or replace the temporary ones I was forced to take to move past that screen.

Oh and now one of the videos on my journey calendar won't even play (appears to be a glitch) so it's gonna count as a missed workout

reviews.title: Wanted to love this App so much
reviews.text:
I bought the Pilates mat set at target and saw that there was an app along with it to do workouts and track your weight, mood, food and water intake, etc. I loved all of it and how it wasn’t too overwhelming to maneuver throughout the app. 

I ended up cancelling my subscription after just a few days because each morning I’d go to workout, I’d cast it to my tv and all of a sudden my videos would not work. It didn’t matter if I took it off cast and tried again. I tried restarting my phone and everything. This happened every morning and I was so frustrated (I am a beginner and wanted a seamless user friendly app and was told this was the best) that I ended up deleting it all together. If I can’t watch the videos or if it crashes every work out, it’s not worth my time or money. It’s unfortunate.

reviews.title: Doesn't work with TV casting
reviews.text:
I started using the free version of the app in November and enrolled in a 15-day free program, which worked great. I loved using the calendar feature, and I could easily watch videos on my Samsung TV by duplicating my iphone’s screen—just like with any other app.

I decided to upgrade to the premium plan on January 1st to access all the features. The first day went smoothly, but on January 2nd, I ran into an issue. Now, whenever I try to cast videos to my TV, they won't play. The videos only play on my phone once I disconnect the cast.

Did something change with the update on January 2nd, or is this issue only affecting premium users? I’m disappointed I can’t watch the videos on the big screen anymore.

reviews.title: The best and most positive workout app!
reviews.text: I love this app so much! I’ve been using it on and off for 4 years and it’s just so encouraging and challenging and as someone who hates exercising, I love exercising with Cassy! That said, on the journey program, there are TOO MANY consecutive leg and glute days. Because the workouts are genuinely challenging and rewarding, my legs get painfully sore. I’ll work out a different area, but those workouts don’t count towards the journey workouts, which I is unfortunate. I would recommend tweaking the algorithm to make the focus areas more balanced each week. Other than that, I recommend this app so heartily for any fitness level!
